notes.title: Update 30/06/16
notes.notes:
What a journey it's been - and now it's come to this! A giant update that adds to the game, and streamlines it even further. Achievements, a third rare weapon, bugfixes, difficulty modes, a new resolution option and more!

- Difficulty Modes: Normal, Hard, Expert (the default is normal).
- New Resolution: 800 * 576.
- 24 Brand-new achievements to obtain.
(defeat the Ice Pixie, Fire Pixie and Three-Headed Wolf before finishing Lesthorn Castle and also speak to the man in front of the church in Herador City if you are a completionist.)
- The rare weapon: spear is now hiding in the depths of a secret room!
- World changes: the tent in the North of Kirita Forest can now be used for resting in, and the Science Lab puzzle has been modified to be more intuitive.
- A few dialogue tweaks.
- Minor balance modifications.
[ This update released, 30/06/16 ] 

If you have any issues, please submit a bug report in the forum's Official Bug Reports topic.

Thanks!

notes.title: Update 10/01/16
notes.notes:
As always, thanks for purchasing and playing Beyond Reality! Over the last few days, a few patches have been released to fix some minor issues. Today's patch was the most substantial, with a permanent fix to battle triggering included. Thus, a summary:

- Fixed occasions where battles would stop working unless the game was restarted.
- Modified Morngar/Montague's shop dialogue in the castle.
- Some quality of life improvements.
- Modified some balancing in the midgame to make a couple of fights slightly tougher.
- Moved one very hidden treasure chest to make it more visible. 
- Additional dialogue added to a couple of NPCs.
- Other minor bugfixes including but not limited to NPCs moving about, snow effects not showing up, visual logic errors, etc.
[ This update released, 10/1/16 ]

- A batch of modern names fixed.
- Thief sidequest minor bug (if not initiated by talking to ring owner first) fixed.
- A typo eliminated from a book in the library.
- The toilet is now inspectable :P
- Clarification/extra dialogue added to the Cyclops sidequest.
- A collection of other minor bugs fixed.
[ This update released, 9/1/16 ]

Don't forget to post on the forums if you have any suggestions for the game!
